8.description: Chief McBride reported on community engagements, including reconciliation events and business discussions. The Saskatoon Police Service also hired 15 new recruits, with seven from visible minorities, two Indigenous/Metis, and two female.

chips.text: Chief noted Saskatchewan Police College limited new recruits to 15 seats.
Business owners along 8th Street Corridor discussed issues with the Chief.
Chief committed to prioritizing exemplary candidates for future recruitment cycles.

18.description: Saskatoon Police Service updated on its Truth, Reconciliation and Treaty Implementation project, detailing progress on Indigenous studies training for officers, community engagement, and future plans for promotion exam prerequisites.

chips.text: Long-serving officers and new recruits now receive Indigenous studies training.
The next person to lead Indigenous studies training after Cst. Lyndon's departure is unknown.
SPS will develop a training module as a prerequisite for promotion exams.
